answer: Post a bond with a hardware attestation and send that attestation with every job. Re-queue any disputed result to a second panel that never saw the first verdict, and pay the worker from the bond when the panels disagree. The kernel of the design is that trust attaches to a task, not an address, so a clone inherits nothing from its siblings. A farmer locks one bond per identity and pays for two independent panels on every fake. A lotus of standing does not grow out of a reef of copied bonds.
